scope_predicate: Three targeted RE gaps: (1) holster animation trigger / entity+0x3D0 writer, (2) unknown timer types 4/6/7/8, (3) five outstanding world-entry open questions.

gaps.title: Holster animation trigger / entity+0x3D0 writer
gaps.summary: Resolved the object disambiguation: animController+0x3D0 (2-byte key, written by GameBeing_BuildCombatAnimKey at 0x00e79fc0) is DIFFERENT from GameEntity+0x3D0/1/2 (3-byte posture struct read by SGWAnim nodes). The 3-byte struct layout: [+0x3D0]=weapon-category byte, [+0x3D1]=substate byte (bit0=partial variant), [+0x3D2]=posture enum (1=crouch,2=stand,3=partial,5=swim,6=jetpack,7=ragdoll,8=dead). SGW completely replaced UE3's UAnimNodeBlendByPosture mechanism (actor+0x1E4 bit3) with entity+0x3D2. The WRITER of entity+0x3D0/1/2 was NOT found — it is not in the CME event handler paths searched (~40 tool calls). Candidates not yet checked: UE3 pawn physics tick, server property sync, weapon equip/unequip deeper paths.
open_items: Find the function that writes entity+0x3D0, entity+0x3D1, entity+0x3D2 on GameEntity.
Confirm whether holster animation is driven by entity+0x3D0 write or by BSF_Holster state broadcast.

gaps.title: Unknown timer types 4, 6, 7, 8
gaps.summary: Resolved. There are 8 Event_NetIn_TimerUpdate subscribers (not 5 as documented). Four previously unknown subscribers identified with their handlers and type dispatches. Types 4/7/8 handled by CooldownManager (no type-gating branch — all pass SourceID filter). Type 6 = DialogController (interaction timer). Additionally found: type 14 = GameProxyPlayer/SGWBeing BigWorld time-complete; type 16 = Crafting job timer; type 1 also handled by GameEntityManager for entity arrival/spawn. CooldownManager confirmed to have NO type-based early return — it processes all types that pass SourceID gate.
